units: metres, Y-up in the GLB, origin at base centre at deck level; a building's front (shop side) faces +z in the GLB
window_rule: every pane (glass, win_warm, win_cool, win_stair, beam_lamp) sits in a modelled, recessed, framed opening inside one 2.4 x 3.2 m facade cell; see window_audit.json

materials.facade: walls (atlas cell tiles; the factor is the building's hue)
materials.deck: walking surfaces: boards, deck plates, pavers
materials.win_warm: lit panes and shop bays; uv = (level, window hash)
materials.win_stair: stairwell slot windows, always lit: do not run the lit/dark pane program on it
materials.landmark: Great Lantern bell; uv = (level, panel id)
materials.lantern: lantern strings, street and soffit lamps
materials.neon_a: sign faces on the Tideglyph atlas
materials.beam_lamp: lighthouse lantern-room panes; uv.v = pane bearing / 360

surface.what: iteration 8: one shared texture set on the unlit surface roles (facade, trim, metal, deck) of the assets listed; the GLBs reference it by URI, so it is stored once
surface.reads_as: the atlas MULTIPLIES each material's factors: base colour (a building's hue is its facade factor; an instance's `color.facade` in layout.json replaces it), roughness (G), metallic (B), occlusion (R); the normal map is tangent space, glTF convention
surface.facade_cells: a wall is mapped cell by cell (2.4 m bay x 3.2 m floor = one tile): rows = finish (light render, dark painted render, corrugated sheet, glazed tile on shop floors), columns = windowed / blank / the lowest floor of a block (grime rising)

inhabitant_scale.cast: Glowmere aliens at scale 1.0 (1.66 to 1.79 m)
